subject: dsa
title: Plus One
summary: Add 1 to the last digit and walk left carrying as needed. A digit that overflows past 9 becomes 0 and pushes a carry; the moment a digit stays below 10, the carry stops and the rest is untouched.
problem: A non-negative integer is stored one digit per array cell, most significant first. Add one to it.

steps.caption: The number 129 is stored one digit per cell. Add 1 to it, starting at the last digit and carrying left like grade-school addition.
Start at the last digit. 9 + 1 = 10: write 0 in this cell and carry 1 to the left.
Move left with the carry: 2 + 1 = 3. Since 3 is below 10, there is no new carry.
With no carry left, every digit further to the left stays exactly as it was.
The incremented number is 130. (If every digit were 9, the final carry would prepend a new leading 1.)
